briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent launch intensifies global AGI race with new dialect protocols

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases while regulatory scrutiny grows. Compute shortages persist as demand surges across sectors.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with native multi-agent support. Anthropic Claude 4.1 counters with improved reasoning benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to xAI and Google. New Middle East data centers break ground amid power constraints.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will dialect-based security protocols become standard before the first agent-driven cyber incidents?
